lines.cap: Farmers hire an ass, to protect their sheep.
lines.say: Farmers hire an ass, to protect their sheep.

lines.cap: Night on the farm. A fox creeps toward the flock.
lines.say: Night on the farm. A fox creeps toward the flock.

lines.cap: But standing with the sheep is a donkey. And it's not there by accident.
lines.say: But standing with the sheep is a donkey. And it's not there by accident.

lines.cap: Donkeys don't like dogs, foxes or coyotes. When one gets close, they bray, chase it, and even kick.
lines.say: Donkeys don't like dogs, foxes or coyotes. When one gets close, they bray, chase it, and even kick.

lines.cap: A donkey kick is strong enough to send a fox running.
lines.say: A donkey kick is strong enough to send a fox running.

lines.cap: So some farmers keep a donkey in the field as a full time guard. No training, no salary.
lines.say: So some farmers keep a donkey in the field as a full time guard. No training, no salary.

lines.cap: The trick? One donkey, on its own. Two donkeys tend to hang out with each other, and ignore the sheep.
lines.say: The trick? One donkey, on its own. Two donkeys tend to hang out with each other, and ignore the sheep.

lines.cap: So next time someone calls you an ass, say thank you.
lines.say: So next time someone calls you an ass, say thank you.
